label: Keep the nails; change their neighbour
before: Repeat the comparison at the controller for the hand surface. Change the skin while keeping the nails at the colour you chose. Keep the coordinate gesture simple enough to recognise. Which difference seems to belong to your chosen channels, and which to the surface receiving them?
after: At the controller for the hand surface, leave the nails at the colour you chose and move the point for the skin. Look again at the nails against this new background. Their assigned colour has stayed fixed. Do they still look the same?

label: The next gesture carries the previous choice
before: Choose a colour because you want it, without requiring a naturalistic match. Try a nail or hand that interrupts the palette you expected from this body. What does that choice make possible for your sense of the figure you act through?
after: Choose a colour because you want it, without requiring a naturalistic match. Try a nail or hand that interrupts the palette you expected from this body. Reach for the point again. The hand making the next choice is already wearing the last one.
